title: genista hirsuta subsp. algarbiensis
intro: Genista hirsuta subsp. algarbiensis, commonly known as Algarve broom, is a subspecies of shrub in the pea family Fabaceae. Algarve broom is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions include treating wounds, fever, and digestive issues, as well as having anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Genista hirsuta subsp. algarbiensis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
